# Day 2 — Probability

Day 2 — Probability / Basics. Math covers basic and compound
probability, random variables and expectation algebra, and conditional
expectation. Programming covers R basics: objects, data types, and
data structures.

This session has two parts:

- **[Math Session](slides.qmd)** — the in-class slideshow.
- **[Programming Session](programming.qmd)** — a webpage walking through the
  same material with runnable R code.
